testing_centers.notes: In-person and online proctored via Kryterion Webassessor

id_requirements: One valid, government-issued photo ID with full name, photo, and signature. Name must match registration exactly.
exam_rules: No notes, books, electronic devices, or study materials. Online: alone in room, no dual monitors, must show room scan via webcam.
renewal_options: Recertify by passing the same or higher-level exam before expiry. Associate certs valid 3 years; Professional certs valid 2 years.

retake_policy.notes: 14-day waiting period after first failed attempt. 60-day waiting period after second failed attempt. 1-year waiting period after third failed attempt within 12 months.

objectives.title: Managing Cloud Identity

Managing a super administrator account
Automating the user lifecycle management process
Administering user accounts and groups programmatically

objectives.title: Managing service accounts
sub_objectives: Securing and protecting service accounts (including default service accounts)
Identifying scenarios requiring service accounts
Creating, disabling, and authorizing service accounts
Securing, auditing, and mitigating the usage of service account keys
Managing and creating short-lived credentials
Configuring Workload Identity Federation
Managing service account impersonation

objectives.title: Managing authentication
sub_objectives: Creating a password and session management policy for user accounts
Setting up Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) and OAuth
Configuring and enforcing 2-step verification

objectives.title: Managing and implementing authorization controls

Applying Policy Intelligence

objectives.title: Defining the resource hierarchy
sub_objectives: Managing folders and projects at scale

domains.name: Securing communications and establishing boundary protection

objectives.title: Designing and configuring perimeter security
sub_objectives: Configuring network perimeter controls (e.g., Cloud Next Generation Firewall [Cloud NGFW] rules and policies, Identity-Aware Proxy [IAP], load balancers, and Certificate Authority Service)

Differentiating between private and public IP addressing
Configuring web application firewalls (e.g., Google Cloud Armor)
Deploying Secure Web Proxy
Configuring Cloud DNS security settings
Continually monitoring and restricting configured APIs

objectives.title: Establishing private connectivity
sub_objectives: Designing and configuring private connectivity between VPC networks and Google Cloud projects (Shared VPC, VPC peering, and Private Google Access for on-premises hosts)

Using Cloud NAT to enable outbound traffic

objectives.title: Protecting sensitive data and preventing data loss

objectives.title: Securing AI workloads

objectives.title: Automating infrastructure and application security

Automating virtual machine and container image creation (e.g., hardening, maintenance, VM patch management)
Managing policy and drift detection at scale (e.g., cloud security posture management, custom organization policies and custom modules for Security Health Analytics)

objectives.title: Configuring logging, monitoring, and detection
